classifications.description: Dental procedure in progress with multiple practitioners wearing surgical loupes and protective equipment, with a monitor mounted on an articulating arm displaying dental X-ray or imaging content above the patient chair.
Dental treatment room with operatory chair, dental equipment, and a wall-mounted monitor displaying visible content on screen, with a city view through the window.
Two medical staff in surgical attire pose in an operating/procedure room with a monitor clearly displaying colorful content in the background among medical equipment and supply shelving.
Modern dental office reception area with curved white desk, dark countertop, flowers, and wood cabinetry, but no television or monitor visible in the patient waiting space.
A dental treatment room with a covered chair, dental equipment, and a wall-mounted TV/monitor displaying visible content above the window, with a laptop on a mobile cart in the foreground.
Dental treatment room with chair, equipment, and city skyline view through large windows, with a wall-mounted monitor/TV visible but screen status cannot be confirmed as powered on with content.

Multiple dental professionals gathered around a patient in a treatment chair with a wall-mounted monitor displaying visible content and a "Special Care Dentistry Association" sign visible in the background.
A dental professional in a teal shirt attends to a patient in a reclined treatment chair, with a wall-mounted TV visible in the upper left showing colored content on screen.
Three medical professionals in surgical attire performing a procedure in an operating room with a monitor visible on the wall, but the monitor's power status and content are not clearly discernible.
